column1: # Reviewed semantic evidence for the OPEN scene-3 controller and its four owned load-image objects.
# The function was checked with OPEN-qualified disassembly/CFG, its sole caller, all callees, strings, data
# references, adjacent functions, generated Ghidra candidate, source history, current match state, and vendor/FID controls.

column6: loads scene 3 and its two texture-page/CLUT pairs; initializes object ids 13 and 14; performs the opening color-matrix fade and counter-rotation; traverses the three-point camera path with a sine perturbation; scrolls and clips two textured overlays; then runs the entity and closing-matrix transitions
column7: sole caller is the OPEN dispatcher at 0x80015870; 47 outgoing references cover every direct call, internal jump, camera/input/entity state access, color-matrix endpoint, and the four owned data objects; the 0x54-byte camera path, 0x10-byte mutable rectangle pair, eight UV bytes, and four color bytes all match retail exactly; no strings
column8: no incoming argument is consumed and no result escapes; s16 blend and overlay counters, s32 12-bit wave phase, signed rectangle Y clipping from -255 through 239, VECTOR transition position, and entity rotation widths follow direct instructions
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and Psy-Q/FID attribution; SDK texture, GTE, and trigonometry callees are separately identified providers while the resource, entity, camera, input, and overlay sequencing is game-owned opening policy
column12: complete semantic C with supported identity, signature, call set, CFG, constants, widths, referents, delay-slot schedule, and byte-exact owned data; every instruction and relocation after the prologue matches retail, but retail reserves a 112-byte frame while the live-source probe reserves 96 bytes, changing only seven prologue and seven epilogue immediates; one extra unused 16-byte aggregate makes the object exact, but its type and meaning are underdetermined, so artificial padding is intentionally not retained
